The '''Red Snapper''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] and on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Summer]] and [[Fall]] during [[Weather|rainy]] weather. It can also be caught during [[Winter]] if a [[Rain Totem]] is used. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during [[Summer]], [[Fall]], or [[Winter]], or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|50}}.

Red Snapper can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Map==
The Red Snapper can be found in the ocean.

==Tailoring==
Red Snapper can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]]. It also can be used as a red dye in the [[Sewing Machine]] or [[Dyeing|Dye Pots]], which can be found in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Red Snappers can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is red-colored Red Snapper [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One red snapper may be randomly requested in [[Summer]], [[Fall]], or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|150}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-4 red snappers during [[Summer]] or [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|50}} per fish. (You get to keep the fish).

==Bugs==
*Red Snapper may be requested in a '''Fishing''' quest during Winter, requiring a [[Rain Totem]] to be caught, despite 1.6.4 version patch notes detailing its removal from the quest.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Added iridium quality. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
{{History|1.6.4|Can no longer be requested by [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] in a [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|Fishing Help Wanted quest]] during [[Winter]].}}
